hero.layout: 2-column grid. Left: Value prop text. Right: Large Light Form.
hero.background: Dark background with heavy overlay image (opacity 20-30%)
hero.form: White background, black text, increased padding (p-8), solid white core for absolute legibility. CTA Button is primary gold.

faculty_grid.layout: Static grid (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 or 5). NO carousels.
faculty_grid.style: Clean cards. Profile image, name, title, and organization logos using react-icons/si or text.

cta_buttons.primary: bg-[#C5A059] text-white hover:bg-[#B38F4D] transition-all rounded-md px-6 py-3 font-medium
cta_buttons.curriculum: Must be the exact primary gold color.
cta_buttons.mobile_sticky: Fixed bottom-right, z-50. Two circular buttons (Call & WhatsApp) stacked vertically.

who_is_this_for.icons: Use Lucide React icons instead of 01, 02, etc.

job_placement_infographic.layout: Visual data section. 3 main stats block. Use a minimalist CSS bar chart or prominent typography for numbers (e.g., 91%, ₹XX L Salary Hike).

pop_up_form.style: Shadcn Dialog. Light theme form inside to maintain contrast.

video_showcase.layout: Centered section with large 16:9 thumbnail, a gold play button overlay. Clicking can open a Shadcn Dialog with an iframe/video player.

image_urls.description: Dark premium office background for hero section
Background for who is this for section if needed

iconography.instructions: Use standard Lucide icons for the 'Who is this for' audience section (Briefcase, LineChart, Users, Database, etc.). Use react-icons/si for tools: SiPython, SiR, SiOpenai, SiAnthropic, SiZapier. Use react-icons for companies (SiLinkedin, SiJpmorganchase) and generic Building/University icons for NYU/Columbia if SVGs are unavailable.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install required fonts from Google Fonts: Cormorant Garamond (headings) and Manrope (body). Map them in tailwind.config.js.
Do NOT use Inter font anywhere.
Follow the theme of 'Old Money Tech' - serious, executive, intellectual.
Remove all references and text containing 'Cohort 01'.
Hero section: Apply `#0A0F1C` dark background with `opacity-20` image overlay. Render a large prominent LIGHT-colored lead form on the right side.
Faculty section: Render as a static CSS grid. DO NOT use moving carousels or marquee logic. Include the provided image URLs for faculty members.
Curriculum CTA: The 'See detailed curriculum...' button MUST use the Gold Background (`bg-[#C5A059]`).
Audience section ('Who is the programme for'): Use Lucide React icons instead of numbers for the 6 cards. Format as a bento grid.
Job placement infographic: Build a visually appealing stats/infographic section representing placement stats, salary hike, role placements.
Video showcase: Add a new section featuring a video layout (prominent thumbnail with play icon).
Mobile sticky buttons: Create two fixed circular buttons (z-50) at the bottom right for Mobile screens only (`sm:hidden`). One for Call (Phone), one for WhatsApp. Use appropriate styling.
Social media: Add social icons (Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, YouTube) to both the desktop top nav bar and footer.
15-second pop-up form: Implement using Shadcn Dialog and React's useEffect timer. Fields: Name, Email, Phone, Course. CTA: 'Schedule Call Back'.
Ensure every interactive element and key informational section has a `data-testid` attribute.
